artworks.title: Glen Onoko, Onoko Falls
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall flowing over a rocky cliff. The viewpoint is from below the falls, looking up at the cascading water. Foliage covers the top of the falls, obscuring the horizon. The waterfall appears blurred due to long exposure, contrasting with the sharp rocks. The color scheme is sepia, giving a vintage look. Rocks, vegetation, and some leaves are visible in the foreground.

artworks.title: Ganoga Lake Branch
artworks.description: The image displays railway tracks running through a dense forest. The tracks extend diagonally into the forested landscape, with tall trees bordering them. The foliage forms a canopy over the tracks, obscuring the sky. The trees are detailed, showing their leaves and bark. The color palette is a sepia tone, giving the image an aged look. Logs and stumps are visible along the track's path.

artworks.title: Across Country from West Portal, N.J.
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high in the image, with distant hills fading into the sky. Small wooden farmhouses, barns, trees, and open fields are visible on rolling hills. Some barns with slanted roofs are on the right, and a few cows are grazing to the left. The color palette is sepia tones, giving a vintage and tranquil atmosphere. Trees line a winding road leading to the hazy background.

artworks.title: The Susquehanna Near Wyalusing
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape with a large tree to the left and a horizon with water and trees in the distance. A forested hill extends across the right side. The color palette is composed of muted sepia tones, giving the image a warm, earthy feel. The scene is rich in vegetation, including various shrubs and grasses.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.description: The image shows a large, multi-story historical building on the right side of the frame. The building has ornate architectural detailing and reaches towards the sky. The horizon is low in the image, with manicured grass sloping up to the building. In the distance to the left, another structure with a spire is partially visible through trees. The image has a sepia-toned color palette. A gravel path runs along the front of the image, bordered by a lawn, trees, and shrubs. There are light and shadow variations indicating a bright day. The photograph conveys a sense of tranquility and historic significance.

artworks.title: Ganoga Lake
artworks.description: The image shows a lakeside scene with a mixture of bare ground, foliage, and a tree trunk in the foreground. Beyond is a small clearing leading to a calm lake, with trees and a distant treeline on the opposite shore. On the right, trees partially block the sky, and two figures are silhouetted against the water while sitting on a fallen log. The overall tone of the image is warm sepia, resembling an early photograph.

artworks.title: The Lehigh, At Turkey Run
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with railway tracks curving to the left and disappearing into the distance, bordered by trees. A tree stands prominently in the foreground, with the horizon in the upper third of the image. Hills line the background, with a river running through the right side of the scene. The color palette is monochrome, with varying shades of sepia creating a vintage look. The image is sharp with a focus on natural elements, and the distant landscape fades into a gentle haze.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.description: The image depicts a street-level view of a grand, multi-story building with distinctive architectural features. The building has arched windows and an ornate tower, situated on the right side of the scene. The horizon is suggested by a row of trees and the roofline of the building. In the foreground, there is a horse-drawn carriage with one person holding the reins. The scene is in sepia tones, evoking an antique feel, with a color palette mostly in shades of brown and beige. Trees line the street, casting shadows and adding depth to the image.

artworks.title: Cayuga Lake, Sheldrake
artworks.description: The image is taken from the edge of a shoreline with tall trees lining the water's edge. The horizon shows a distant landmass across a body of water beyond the trees and water. The color palette is mostly sepia tones, giving the scene a vintage feel. A pebbled shore extends along the lower part of the image with gentle waves, and a person is partially obscured by a tree at the water's edge. In the distance, there is a view of water and blurry land, creating a tranquil atmosphere. Trees on the right side frame the scene with their leaves creating patterns against the sky.

artworks.title: Seneca Lake and Watkins
artworks.description: The image features a rural landscape with dark trees and rooftops in the foreground, leading to a small town with a church steeple and tower. A large body of water is visible in the background, bordered by fields, hills, and distant hills. The sepia-toned photograph has a nostalgic and timeless quality.

artworks.title: Rockdale Curve, On the Lehigh
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with parallel railway tracks curving away in the mid-ground. A river runs to the left of the tracks with lush vegetation along its banks, while a steep, forested cliff is on the right. There are distant treetops, buildings, and an expansive sky in the background. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing texture and depth. The image has a precise and clean photographic style with clear detail.

artworks.title: Easton, Pardee Hall, Lafayette College
artworks.description: The image shows a grand stone building with elaborate architectural design. The building obscures the horizon and dominates the image. It features intricate detailing, symmetrical design, dormer windows, and ornate rooftop railings. In front of the building is a grassy lawn with trees and shrubs, and a winding path. The sky is pale. The photo is sepia-toned, emphasizing the textures of the building and landscape.

artworks.title: Hemlock Run Curve, Near Towanda
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white photograph of a railway track curving to the left. Along the track are steep tree-covered embankments on the left and a calm river on the right. In the distance, wooded hills meet the sky, with telephone poles lining the railway track. The sky is overcast, and the overall ambiance is serene and timeless.

artworks.title: Towanda From Table Rock
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view from a rocky vantage point, with a town stretching out beyond a river. The town features a mix of rectangular and pointed rooftops, lined streets, and trees. A bridge crosses the river, connecting the banks. Rolling hills rise in the distance, hazy against the pale sky. The photo uses a sepia-toned palette, highlighting contrasts between the light sky and darker elements of the town and rock formation in the foreground.

artworks.title: York Narrows, On The Susquehanna
artworks.description: The image shows a river flowing through a valley, with a railway track running parallel to it. Lush vegetation lines the railway track, leading towards a hill covered in dense forest. The river reflects the sky, with the scene dominated by sepia tones.

artworks.title: Susquehanna at Standing Stone
artworks.description: A river flows diagonally across the scene, flanked by a forested hillside in the distance. Lush vegetation surrounds the foreground, with a sepia tone giving the image a vintage feel.

artworks.title: Musconetcong Glen
artworks.description: The image shows a railway track curving through a forest. The track disappears into the dense trees that line both sides, creating a natural canopy framing the railway. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a clear view of the tracks leading into the distance. The monochromatic sepia-toned photograph has deep shadows cast by the trees, highlighting their texture. The overall impression is one of tranquility and natural beauty, with the railway blending into the lush landscape.

artworks.title: Picturesque Susquehanna, Near Laceyville
artworks.description: The image features an elevated view over a landscape with a large tree on the right and a field of crops on the left. In the distance, hills and a river can be seen. The color palette is sepia-toned, with brown and beige tones highlighting the different elements in the landscape.

artworks.title: Shawanese Lake
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront scene with a boat docked, people on board, trees lining the edges, and a hill in the background. The water is calm with reflections of the trees. The road next to the water is unpaved. The color scheme is sepia, creating a vintage look with muted browns and light shades.

artworks.title: Nesquehoning Valley, From Packer's Point
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden pavilion on a rocky outcrop surrounded by trees, with people inside. In the distance, there are rolling terrains leading towards a faint horizon. The color palette is sepia, with subtle contrasts between the structure and the foliage.

artworks.title: Cliff View, Summit of Alleghenies
artworks.description: The image shows a high vantage point overlooking the Alleghenies. In the foreground, there is a rocky ledge with bushes. Beyond, there is a densely forested landscape with rolling hills. The mountains fade into the sky. The color palette is sepia-toned. The rocks and trees are detailed.

artworks.title: Morris Canal From Green's Bridge
artworks.description: The image shows a canal with narrowboats moored on the left side, surrounded by trees. In the distance, hills are faintly visible. The scene is depicted in sepia tones, creating a nostalgic atmosphere. A dirt road leads to buildings on the right, with a carriage parked nearby. Shadows imply a bright light source, potentially the midday sun.

artworks.title: The Susquehanna At Wyalusing
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river, dense foliage, tall grasses, a meandering river, trees along the riverbank, a forested hill, and a calm sky. The style is a classical sepia photograph, with a monochromatic color palette. Large trees are also visible on the left side.

artworks.title: Easton, From Weygat Mountain
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a town surrounded by hills and a river. The town has various buildings and a prominent church. The river winds through the town and leads to hills in the distance. The color scheme is sepia-toned, giving the scene an old-fashioned appearance. In the foreground, there are rocks and vegetation.
